title: Algebra: Substitution
description: Writing algebraic expressions from words, substituting numbers for letters, and using simple formulas.

notes.heading: Writing Expressions from Words
notes.body: Letters (variables) stand for unknown numbers. Translate: "more than" → +, "less than" → −, "times/of" → ×, "shared between" → ÷. For multiplication, write number first without ×: "5 times n" = 5n. "A number plus 7" = n+7. "Twice a number minus 3" = 2n−3.

notes.heading: Substituting Values
notes.body: Replace the letter with the given number and evaluate using BIDMAS. Example: If a=3, 4a+5 = 4×3+5 = 17. Watch exponents: 3x² means 3×(x²), not (3x)². If x=5, 3x² = 3×25 = 75.

notes.heading: Using Simple Formulas
notes.body: A formula is a rule connecting quantities. e.g., perimeter P=2(l+w). If l=8cm, w=5cm: P=2(8+5)=26cm. Common formulas: perimeter P=2l+2w, area A=lw, cost C=np. Write formula first, substitute, then calculate step by step.

notes.heading: Expanding Brackets
notes.body: Multiply the term outside by EVERY term inside: a(b+c) = ab+ac. Example: 3(x+4)=3x+12. 5(2y−3)=10y−15. Negative outside: −2(x−5)=−2x+10. Always expand before adding/subtracting other terms.

notes.heading: ⚠️ Substitution and negative numbers
notes.body: When substituting a negative number, use brackets to keep the sign correct. If x = −3, then 2x = 2 × (−3) = −6. Without brackets it is easy to write 2 × −3 and get confused.

notes.heading: ✅ Order matters
notes.body: In an expression like 2a + 3b, multiply before you add. If a=4 and b=2: 2×4 + 3×2 = 8 + 6 = 14. Do not add 4+2 first.

questions.stem: "Five more than a number n" — write the expression.

questions.explanation: Substitute x=4 into 3x+7. First multiply: 3×4=12. Then add 7: 12+7=19. So 3x+7=19.

questions.stem: If a=3 and b=5, what is 2a+4b?

questions.explanation: Substitute y=4 into y²+3. First work out 4²=16. Then add 3: 16+3=19. So y²+3=19.

questions.stem: Taxi: £3 plus £2 per mile. Expression for cost of m miles?
Find perimeter using P=2l+2w when l=6cm, w=4cm.

questions.stem: A taxi charges £4 plus £3 per mile. How much does a 7-mile journey cost?
If a = 4 and b = 2, which expression gives the largest value?
questions.explanation: Substitute a=4, b=2. a+b=6; 2a+b=8+2=10; a²+b=16+2=18; a+b²=4+4=8. The largest value is 18 from a² + b.

questions.stem: The area of a triangle is A = 1/2 × base × height. Find the area when base = 8 cm and height = 5 cm.
questions.explanation: Substitute: A = 1/2 × 8 × 5. First, 1/2 × 8 = 4, then 4 × 5 = 20. The area is 20 cm².
